definitions.explanation: To go beyond a limit or amount.

definitions.gloss: to pass through, to tide over
definitions.explanation: To get through a difficult time.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す。
⟦{気温|きおん}→気温：00235_kion⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{四十度|よんじゅうど}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}した。
⟦{参加者|さんかしゃ}→参加者：03059_sankasha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{百人|ひゃくにん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}して、⟦{会場|かいじょう}→会場：01269_kaijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|はい}りきれなかった→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: The number of participants exceeded a hundred, and they couldn't all fit in the venue.

examples.japanese: ⟦{厳|きび}しい→厳しい：01125_kibishii⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}して、⟦やっと→やっと：01561_yatto⟧⟦{落|お}ち{着|つ}いた→落ち着く：04670_ochitsuku⟧。
examples.english: After getting through the tough period, things finally settled down.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何度|なんど}→何度：17592_nando⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{困難|こんなん}→困難：01410_konnan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}してきた⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{怖|こわ}くない→怖い：00864_kowai⟧。
examples.english: Because I have the experience of getting through difficulties many times, I'm no longer afraid.

notes:
{超|こ}す is a godan verb meaning to exceed or surpass a limit.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ particle: 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed the budget
- ⟦{限度|げんど}→限度：00063_gendo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed the limit
- ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed expectations
- ⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{超|こ}す: to exceed one million

KANJI DISTINCTION (same reading):
- {超|こ}す: to exceed, surpass (abstract limits)
- ⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧: to cross over, pass through (physical movement)

SIMILAR:
- ⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧: same meaning (ichidan verb variant)
- ⟦{上回|うわまわ}る→上回る：07648_uwamawaru⟧: to surpass, exceed
